operating_conditions.supply: regulated positive 12V +/-5%; Thevenin source resistance sensitivity up to 0.5ohm
operating_conditions.Core_1A: extra transient sensitivity, not a claim of the Core maximum consumption
operating_conditions.local_3V3: normally <=10mA; no external PMOD power loads
operating_conditions.ambient: 0..50C as modeled; no enclosure thermal qualification

limits: TI original switching model completed the simple reference circuit; extra parasitic/full-variant decks stopped with ngspice timestep errors and are not marked successful.
Averaged model uses TI compensation network and is matched to one vendor-model operating point; low-load DCM, pulse skipping, hiccup and IC process corners are incompletely modeled.
XC6206 is a fit to a 3.0V family typical curve, not a manufacturer model of the selected 3.3V part.
50mA fast local-load steps can violate the +/-5% rail target; they are not within the actual carrier local-load budget.
K50 PG does not certify Core operation above 4.5V throughout power-down. Communication must stop, ARM be released, and DDR3 be reinitialized after stable power.
Do not rely on extended reverse-polarity protection or real USB-PD current-limit/negotiation behavior from these voltage-profile models.
